_comment: Cron schedules are set per-service in the Railway dashboard; this file documents
the intended commands so they are versioned rather than living only in a UI.
All times UTC. The filing deadline is a Texas date, so never let a cron boundary
decide a legal one — the calendar generator owns the dates.
Exits non-zero when a job has not run. This exists because Railway documents no
cron retry: a job that never fires produces no error, no log line and no alert,
and during the filing window a silently skipped day is a candidate never seen.
